learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover what makes friendship so special and how we can be good friends to others.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Good friends always share their toys and lunch. Sharing makes everyone happy and brings big smiles.
When a friend is sad or falls down, a best friend helps them get up. We must always take care of each other.
Games are so much more fun when we play them with our friends. Every day is an adventure with a best friend!

fun_activity.title: 💌 Friendship Card
fun_activity.instructions: Make a beautiful card for your best friend. Draw some stars on it and write Thank You for being my friend!

quick_recap: ⭐ Best friends share their things and play together.
⭐ We should always help our friends when they need us.
⭐ Having a good friend makes our lives joyful.
